constraints.entry: Basic coding; AI prelearning is not required

PY-VARIABLES.task: Trace assignment and distinguish a stored value from a displayed string.
PY-VARIABLES.expected: Predict and justify the value used by the next statement.

PY-CONTROL.task: Trace a conditional and a bounded loop on a short list.
PY-CONTROL.expected: Give the selected branch, iteration count and resulting values.

PY-FUNCTION.task: Use a parameter and return a computed value to a caller.
PY-FUNCTION.expected: Distinguish return from print and reuse the returned value.

PY-LIST.task: Select an indexed list element and a slice without changing the original accidentally.
PY-LIST.expected: Identify index boundaries and the selected values.

PY-FILE.task: Open a supplied local CSV and identify its header and rows.
PY-FILE.expected: Resolve the stated path and distinguish missing file from missing column.

PY-ERROR.task: Read a short traceback and locate the first relevant error.
PY-ERROR.expected: Name the failing operation and propose a testable correction.

MATH-MEAN.task: Compute the arithmetic mean of a short finite list.
MATH-MEAN.expected: State the sum, count and resulting quantity; bridge before axis reductions.

MATH-RATIO.task: Interpret counts as a fraction with an explicitly named denominator.
MATH-RATIO.expected: Explain the counted population and detect an absent denominator.

ARRAY-AXIS.task: Predict the output shape of a 2D reduction over each axis.
ARRAY-AXIS.expected: Distinguish the removed axis from the retained output dimensions.

units.theory: Explain state changes, control flow and return values needed by the supplied data procedure.
units.noncoding: Predict a short procedure before running it and identify a counterexample to the mistaken return/print equivalence.
units.coding: Modify a small supplied procedure and check its returned value and stated error behavior.
units.assessment: Use changed inputs without the completed solution visible; state assistance and explain a failed case.
units.time_location: Week 1 coding block: the existing 20-minute Python diagnosis; prior support remains outside class.

units.theory: Define a record, column, feature and target in the same data dictionary; distinguish missing from zero.
units.noncoding: Predict selected rows/columns and missing-value counts from a small table.
units.coding: Read the stated CSV, select the requested subset, inspect dtype/shape and count missing values; do not silently impute in week 1.
units.assessment: Apply the same stated contract to changed column names and a documented missing-column case.
units.time_location: Week 1 coding: CSV selection and missing-value inspection in the existing 40-minute block.

units.theory: Define shape and reduction axis; explicitly state that this check uses rectangular 2D arrays with keepdims false.
units.noncoding: Predict the retained dimensions and independently calculate column and row means.
units.coding: Run both axis reductions on the same array and reconcile values and output shape with the prediction.
units.assessment: Use a new rectangular array and explain why the output length changes with the selected axis.
units.time_location: Week 1 theory/noncoding/NumPy blocks; no extra class time is appended.

units.theory: Distinguish the plotted quantity, aggregation and axis units from the underlying raw records.
units.noncoding: Read a graph and match its axes and aggregation to a stated table quantity.
units.coding: Create the required labeled graph and interpret it; record Matplotlib and Seaborn evidence separately when claiming the full grouped item.
units.assessment: Change an input condition and explain the resulting graph rather than merely displaying an image.
units.time_location: Matplotlib belongs to the existing week 1 class; the plan's Seaborn obligation is required outside work.

units.theory: Distinguish learning from training data, choosing settings with validation, and final test estimation; state group/time assumptions.
units.noncoding: Assign source IDs to splits and identify which operations would expose held-out information.
units.coding: Split before fitting learned transformations and check row/group/time constraints appropriate to the stated data.
units.assessment: Identify a counterexample with disjoint row IDs but shared subjects or future information.
units.time_location: Week 2 split block; preserve the test embargo through final week 4 selection and required outside work.

units.theory: Define fitted statistics and distinguish fit from applying a fixed transform; name the statistic and its training population.
units.noncoding: Predict how a held-out outlier would incorrectly change a statistic if fitted on all rows.
units.coding: Fit the stated imputer/scaler in the training pipeline and transform validation without refitting; keep required component evidence separate.
units.assessment: Audit a changed pipeline and identify the specific information path causing or avoiding leakage.
units.time_location: Week 2 existing 20-minute pipeline block plus separately accounted required outside preprocessing work.

units.theory: Define TP/FP/FN/TN using the positive label and give the population counted by each denominator.
units.noncoding: Compute accuracy, precision and recall independently from a confusion table; distinguish undefined ratios from zero.
units.coding: Reconcile library and hand results under the same label and zero-division conventions; F1/ROC outside work stays separate.
units.assessment: Use changed counts and an undefined case; explain which error affects precision versus recall.
units.time_location: Week 2 noncoding 20-minute calculation within 30 minutes, which already includes 10 minutes of written practice.

units.theory: Define a baseline predictor and distinguish its validation result from final generalization evidence.
units.noncoding: Predict a dummy strategy's behavior on a stated class distribution and name the comparison condition.
units.coding: Fit and evaluate the declared DummyClassifier baseline on validation data with the fixed split and pipeline.
units.assessment: Explain a model choice using validation evidence while keeping test labels/results unavailable through final week 4 selection.
units.time_location: Week 2 existing 20-minute dummy-model block; no test-driven tuning or added class period.

unresolved.diagnostic_cutoff: The HTML's 4/5 and 3/4 targets are retained as source proposals; numeric readiness policy needs agreement and calibration.
unresolved.outside_work_limit: Required outside-work schedule is recorded separately; acceptable individual limit and support allocation are not inferred.
unresolved.evidence: No student responses, notebooks, classroom timings or learning outcomes are created by this specification.

explanation_contract: Required T-checks are scoped minimums; declare and review any additional representations actually used. These are production specifications, not completed lesson material.
